data.other_hard: You must submit a complete HDR admission application to the University of Sydney by the applicable deadline; Research experience is not a mandatory requirement; Students who had already commenced their research degree in Australia or who became an Australian permanent resident prior to commencement/completion are not eligible
data.evidence_sentence: Students who had already commenced their research degree in Australia or who became an Australian permanent resident prior to commencement/completion are not eligible.
data.notes: Page is an FAQ, not the award terms; funding_type full is not stated explicitly and is uncertain; the page does not state citizenship or nationality rules, GPA, or field of study; the 'You may be eligible if' residency-related conditions apply to a relocation allowance context and were not treated as nationality; deadlines are referenced to an external timeline and no dates are given; the page says current enrolled students are considered in the next round and the 'enrolled' status was not added; relocation reimbursement is for International/RTP International Scholarship holders and was not clearly tied to the RTP scholarship itself; the award is described as for postgraduate research degrees (master's by research or PhD).
